steps.prompt:
Create a NEW Chinese desktop space-idle game interface concept, one full-window main view. Work canvas is 1440x900 (8:5). LEFT planetary module occupies x=0..807 (56.11% of width), RIGHT reference battlefield x=808..1439 (43.89%). Use reference image 1's full-window proportions, gentle ivory/deep teal visual language, and RIGHT battlefield appearance. Replace its LEFT equipment layout completely. Do NOT copy its nested equipment frames or equipment cards. RIGHT battlefield is contextual reference only: retain the existing cream/navy ship, drones, restrained cyan weapon beam and dark space rather than inventing new ships or shields. Remove P3/demo/review labels. No device mockup or outer presentation margin.

Reference roles: 1 = approved warm control materials and full-window battlefield reference. 2 = ACTUAL OLD GAME planet appearance: a simple cel-shaded teal ocean globe with broad pale olive/cream continents, sparse separate cloud bands, subdued fixed illumination and a gentle shaded blue limb. 3 = existing refinery model identity: TWO HORIZONTAL parallel ivory cylinders with ochre surfaces beside a teal rectangular center; not three vertical tanks. 4 = existing workshop identity: ivory compact PRESS with an ochre overhanging top on an ivory upright and deep teal plinth; not a factory tower. 5 = actual ivory U-shaped shipyard identity. A space station has an ivory compact hub and TWO broad flat blue solar wings. Scout is a small pointed ivory/navy ship with cyan thrust. Preserve these existing recognizable silhouettes, no ornate replacement models.

THE WHOLE LEFT MODULE IS ONE CONTINUOUS ORBITAL OBSERVATION SCENE. It is not a globe inside a panel, not a big painted globe surrounded by four display miniatures, not a dashboard. Low-saturation blue-gray and deep teal orbital space extends directly to all lateral module edges with NO inset frame and NO rounded scene box. Warm ivory is reserved for the global masthead and slim scene-edge controls. Scene transition and light structures are soft and spacious, related to the shared style. Sparse very quiet stars, NO field of asteroids or rubble. The sustained viewing subject is planet surface motion, independent cloud drift, and craft/structures passing in front of and behind a planet. This is ONE t=0 design frame of that scene, no motion arrows or explanation text in the product UI.

Important scale: Globe center about (370,450) in the 1440x900 client, diameter ONLY 375px, approximately 47% of the 808px module width. Keep full globe visible and leave substantial orbital negative space around it. Do not enlarge it to fill the module. Broad cel continent patches matching actual old game, simple pale sparse clouds, light from upper-left, stable dusk shading toward lower-right. Atmosphere thin and subdued, NO bright glowing full ring, no realistic noisy terrain. Spherical edge compression, calm material, noticeably rounded shading rather than a flat round emblem.

ORBITAL SPATIAL RELATIONSHIPS MUST BE VISIBLE:
Thin asymmetric tilted orbital ellipses, faint back arcs and clearer front arcs, with back arcs disappearing completely behind the globe wherever overlapping. Orbit paths can extend toward module edges; no ring-framing of an inner viewport.
Station near the UPPER-LEFT globe limb approximately (220,350), BEHIND the planet: the globe must mask the station's inner wing/body while an outer blue wing remains visible beyond the globe edge. Do not draw the whole station in front of the planet or on a continent. A fine leader from a visible part to "空间站 · 已领取" in nearby left space.
Workshop on the front lower-right orbital arc around (500,585), entirely in front, existing press identity with clean soft volume. Label "工坊 · 已领取".
Ready refinery in left-lower orbital space around (135,615), existing two-horizontal-tank silhouette. It is a claimable unowned object represented with a restrained amber status locator, NOT an active running factory. Nearby "精炼厂 · 待领取" and one small amber "领取" button. No active multiplier or production effects.
Shipyard around (615,695), stationary construction location. Use a visibly UNFINISHED muted structural/blueprint silhouette based on reference 5's open U-shape, not a complete active owned dock. Selected marker modest and local. Stable readout beside it in safe empty space: "船坞 · 施工中", "38 / 180 次", "施工人员 1 / 1". Numeric construction count is sufficient; NO shipyard progress bar. No claim action here.
Facility sprites are about 45-70px wide at the 1440px client scale, not huge product renders. They occupy real orbital relationships, NOT four equally spaced corners.
Scout on the FRONT right-lower orbital segment, around (580,510), smaller than facilities, bow following path tangent, short restrained wake. Nearby calm readout "探索中", "探索者 1 人", "本次进度 68%" with a short thin cyan progress track. Labels sit in stable nearby free space with small leaders rather than buttons glued to moving artwork.

Product edge furniture:
Top warm ivory masthead y=0..60 in left module: small diamond logo "远航舰桥", compact resource readings "铁 128.6M", "铀 8.4M", "碎片 2.1K", status "交战中" and small "暂停".
Compact one-line module navigation near y=65..100: "装备  反应炉  科研  船员  星球  星系", 星球 selected. No navigation duplicates.
At scene upper-left around (28,132): "始源星 E178b", smaller "探索度 68", compact previous/next selectors. No degree percentage bar, no six-row planet sidebar.
Bottom scene-edge ivory console near y=815..900: "自动探索 · 开启", teal primary button "本次完成后停止"; separate quiet danger "立即取消探索". "累计加成" compact secondary, "重铸预览" disabled, reason "船坞未领取". No automatic toggle duplication. Console integrated along field edge, not nested in another big panel.
Keep necessary Chinese concise and readable. No design headings, P3 labels, teaching instructions, "t=0", layer names or arrows on the product view. All visible labels belong to real objects/state. No separate explanation sidebar.

Do not choose or advertise a 2D versus 3D renderer. This image specifies visible spatial design only. Main image remains a single calm full-window gameplay concept.

Correct this full-window planetary game concept (reference 1) in ONE bounded revision, preserving the continuous deep teal orbital scene and existing right battlefield visuals. Reference 2 is the original 1440x900 proportion/style reference, reference 3 actual space-station model, reference 4 actual workshop model. Do not redesign ships/shields on the right.

REQUIRED content corrections:
A. The existing WORKSHOP is MISSING. Add ONE compact ivory/ochre PRESS facility based exactly on reference 4, on the FRONT lower-right orbital arc in front of the planet, about 55-65 client pixels wide. It is distinct from the scaffold shipyard. Its nearby label reads “工坊 · 已领取”. Do NOT replace or remove any other facility. There must be four distinct facility types total: station, refinery, workshop, shipyard.
B. Replace the fancy station at the upper-left planet limb with reference 3's SIMPLE existing model: compact ivory rectangular hub, pale cyan small raised top, TWO broad solid BLUE solar wings, no antenna forest, no grid-detail panels. Keep its inward half properly BEHIND the planet, so the globe masks the inner wing/hub rather than showing the whole station as a sticker on top. Keep “空间站 · 已领取”.
C. Remove the redundant automatic toggle switch at the bottom. Keep “自动探索 · 开启” text and the separate primary “本次完成后停止” action. Other actions “立即取消探索”, “累计加成”, disabled “重铸预览”, reason “船坞未领取” stay.
D. The LEFT module currently occupies too much width. Target reference 2's exact split: 56.11% left planetary module / 43.89% right battlefield. If retaining the current 1586x992 native image, move the divider from approximately x=991 to approximately x=890. At that native size, planet center should be approximately (407,496), diameter approximately 420px. These map to the requested 1440x900 work canvas: divider x=808, globe center around(370,450), diameter about380. Reflow the orbital labels and bottom edge controls within the left side; no clipped Chinese or object labels straddling into the battlefield. This is NOT a request to enlarge the globe.
E. Keep the same quiet cel-style planet surface and sparse cloud bands, fixed upper-left illumination/dusk on lower-right, and subdued atmosphere; no stronger glow. Preserve refinery ready/unclaimed label and claim button, shipyard unfinished U-shaped scaffold and count “38 / 180 次”, “施工人员 1 / 1”, no shipyard progress bar. Current exploration “68%”, one explorer, degree68 stay. Do not add a new inner scene frame.

The entire module remains a shared orbital SPACE with real front/back overlap, not a giant illustration surrounded by four showroom icons. No tutorial, design explanation, P3 or demo labels in the product. Preserve right battlefield only as reference context.

Create ONE wide THREE-PANEL temporal design storyboard, NOT an implemented-game screenshot or animation. It illustrates the LEFT planetary module from reference image 1 at three times in ONE unchanged camera. Each panel repeats the SAME complete module scene and SAME scale, crop, globe center, lighting, UI furniture, orbit paths, and object identities. Do NOT include the right battlefield in the panels.

Layout: three equal vertical panels side by side, intended module work rectangle 808x900 per panel, total nominal 2424x960 including an OUTSIDE annotation strip. No perspective, no device mockup. Only the external top annotation strip says “动态关系示意 · 非实机动画 · 未暂停 · 1× · 探索及施工人员持续在岗”. External small panel headers, outside product view: “t = 0 游戏秒”, “t = 4 游戏秒”, “t = 8 游戏秒”. No layer labels, arrows, timestamps or instructional paragraphs inside the game UI. These are design illustrations, do not claim measured or pixel-exact animation.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1 is the finalized t=0 proposed full-window composition. Extract/reproduce ONLY its left module (warm masthead, compact navigation, dark continuous orbital field, planet, four facility identities, bottom console). It is the exact visual anchor for all THREE panels. Do not invent a different planet, continent layout, facility family or scene.
2 is actual OLD GAME planet after 4 simulated seconds, to guide how the SAME continental pattern moves across a sphere without moving the illumination.
3 is actual OLD GAME planet after 8 simulated seconds, same purpose.
References 2/3's old sidebars, battlefield, window layout and numbers are NOT layout references. Use only their spherical movement relationships. Keep reference1's new composition and materials.

COMMON scene in every panel:
One globe, same center and diameter as reference1's LEFT scene relative to its module, broad teal oceans/pale cream-olive continents, sparse separate white cloud bands. Upper-left light is FIXED, lower-right dusk boundary is FIXED, visible circular silhouette remains fixed. Globe's contour does not turn as a flat picture. No high-frequency new terrain, no new asteroid field, no amplified atmosphere.
Same FOUR facilities and state: compact two-solid-blue-wing space station and ivory/ochre press workshop are 已领取; two-horizontal-tank refinery is 待领取 with one “领取” action; stationary U-shaped unfinished scaffold shipyard is 施工中 with “38 / 180 次” and “施工人员 1 / 1”. Shipyard STAYS FIXED in position across panels. Do not swap types, replace the workshop with the dock, or add a fifth facility. D68 remains D68 and construction count stays38 because the current exploration does not finish within these eight seconds.
Masthead resources and navigation stay the same; “自动探索 · 开启”, “本次完成后停止”, physically separate “立即取消探索”, “累计加成”, disabled “重铸预览 / 船坞未领取” all remain. No duplicate automatic toggle. No P3/review wording in product UI.

Specific three-frame changes:
PANEL t=0: faithfully match reference1's globe map positions and object positions. Exploration reads “本次进度 68%”, “探索者 1 人”. Scout on front right-lower arc with its bow tangent to the path and a very short wake. Station is partially hidden by the planet near upper-left limb, workshop visible in the front lower orbital space. Orbital tracks behind the sphere must be occluded.
PANEL t=4: shift the SAME land pattern slightly LEFT in spherical longitude (about 8.6 degrees), following reference2. Do NOT rotate the whole screen-space globe, light gradient or atmosphere. Cloud pattern moves independently by a slightly larger longitude step (about10.5 degrees), so its relative drift is small, not a large jump. Current exploration reads about “75%”. Scout moves along the SAME projected orbital ellipse to the FRONT lower-left section, oriented tangentially. The station progresses a modest distance behind the limb and is more obscured; do not draw a complete station on the planet. Workshop remains same front-side identity but has a modest changed position/orientation consistent with its own orbit. Labels/readouts stay in stable nearby free space, leaders follow actual visible object parts.
PANEL t=8: land shift about17.3 degrees from t0, guided by reference3. The same recognizable continents change position and compress near the limb; no new geography. Cloud shift about21 degrees from t0 with SMALL relative drift versus land, light stays fixed. Exploration reads about “81%”. Scout has reached the REAR side: hide the occluded part behind the globe instead of placing a complete ship over the continent. Its stable task readout still shows one explorer and81%, no fake cancellation. Preserve at least one clear foreground facility and another partially occluded facility, so front/back distinction is visible. Workshop stays a press, refinery stays ready, dock stays under construction at its fixed position.

Use restrained orbit arcs and silhouettes to express spatial depth. Correct front/back visibility is more important than decorative glow. Never let an occluded craft/structure remain a full front-facing sticker. No extra movement arrows, no altered light direction, no orbital camera change, no fake 3D route selection. Do not turn the three panels into three redesign alternatives: they are three moments of the SAME scene.

Make ONLY ONE small correction to this existing THREE-PANEL design storyboard. Preserve ALL three panel compositions, same planet surface positions, same light direction, same cloud positions, same facility silhouettes/positions, same craft positions and front/back occlusion, all headers and all UI furniture. Do not redraw or restage the frames.

The middle panel headed “t = 4 游戏秒” is missing the stable task readout that exists in the left and right panels. Add the SAME small pale task text block in the same relative RIGHT-side orbital free-space location of the MIDDLE panel, aligned with the t0 and t8 readouts. Text:
“探索中”
“探索者 1 人”
“本次进度 75%”
A short thin cyan progress track may match the other panels and read approximately three quarters. Keep it within the middle panel, readable and not clipped, do not cover the globe or move the scout to make room. The middle scout stays on the front lower-left arc. The stable readout need not be glued to the moving ship.

The left panel remains68%, right panel remains81%. Construction stays38/180 and crew1/1 across all three. Preserve the external annotation “动态关系示意 · 非实机动画 · 未暂停 · 1× · 探索及施工人员持续在岗”. Absolutely no other edits.
